title: Foundation Ledger -- per-project stage-boundary SSOT (ATOM_DECOMP)
description: SOURCE OF RECORD for a project's foundational truth, built BEFORE design/implementation. Andrew-direct 2026-08-10: a structured deliverable is XML or JSON, never markdown; the same fields assessed for all pipelines/axes; dependencies at EVERY boundary; every gate declares which clock it reads; declared truth is recorded WITH whether code was measured to honor it. Absence is always an explicit enum state (UNDECLARED/UNMEASURED/UNKNOWN), never a missing key -- the loud-default law.

project.description: Registered project code this ledger founds

scope_statement.description: The system boundary this ledger claims to cover -- falsifiable

denominator_statement.description: How the row set was enumerated and from what population; a ledger without this cannot claim completeness

derived_renderings.description: Paths of any prose/markdown renderings. THEY ARE DERIVED; where they disagree with this file, this file wins.

firm.description: firm scope of this row; 'GLOBAL' for cross-firm rollup rows; 'ALL' only when one mechanism provably serves every firm identically (cite evidence)

boundary.description: The stage boundary this row founds. One row per (firm x boundary).

name.description: the resource that moves data across this boundary (lambda/EC2 runner/script), exact resource name

expression.description: cron()/rate()/event pattern verbatim, or the completion-marker key. 'UNDECLARED' if unknown.

schedule_exists.description: Estate law: a production pipeline whose only trigger is another pipeline's success has no schedule and is a defect. false here is a FINDING, not a style.

ruled_owner.description: who owns this mover's writes, if ruled (e.g. bronze-prefix ownership); 'UNRULED' otherwise

clocks.description: THE TWO-CLOCK LAW: every artifact carries what the data is OF and when WE produced/landed it.

field.description: where the as-of lives in the artifact (metadata key/column), or 'ABSENT' (a finding)

semantics.description: what day/time the data claims to be of, incl. T-1 semantics if applicable

known_schism_notes.description: any measured divergence pattern between the clocks (e.g. legs firing in the wrong order)

gates.description: EVERY gate/check/guard on this boundary. Empty array is a claim ("no gates here") and carries the population.evidence burden.

reads_clock.description: which clock the gate keys on. UNDECLARED is the defect class that produced five incidents in one week.

declared_behavior.description: what the gate's own config/doc says it does

measured_honored.description: whether code was MEASURED to honor the declaration. A declared value alone is not sufficient -- code has cited a config while contradicting it (route_bindings, 2026-08-10).

evidence.description: file:line@commit / tool+output for the measured verdict; required when measured_honored != UNMEASURED

authority.description: the ONE frontier definition this row binds to (lib/trading_calendar.py) or the deviation, stated

roll_forward.description: any roll-forward/carry-forward behavior on this boundary, or 'NONE'

dependencies.description: AT EVERY BOUNDARY, never solely at serving (Andrew-direct 2026-08-10). Empty array claims independence and carries the evidence burden.

declared.description: what the declared truth says about this coupling (or 'UNDECLARED')

consumers.description: downstream consumers of this boundary's artifact; empty claims none and carries the burden

status.description: the only two legal states. UNKNOWN_WITH_OWNER requires owner + reason; a blank row cannot exist in a valid instance.

evidence.description: instrument + output the row's facts rest on (Rule 5: source, locator, time, scope, count grain, denominator, limitation)
